name: Majo no Shokeibi ~Jougen no Tsuki wa Watashi o Mikudashi~ Zenpen
original_name: 魔女の処刑日 ～上弦の月は私を見下し～ 前編
source:
There once was a witch named Yaneko. She worked at the breadshop and was friendly with the people. 

When a mysterious plague descended on the town, those people turned against her...... 
Her friendly neighbors became a bloodthirsty mob, 
and when they killed Yaneko's father for no reason at all, 
she vowed revenge...... 

This is a heartfelt, emotional Otome Witch fantasy novel about suffering and revenge set in medieval Europe.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE124817.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
从前有一个名叫“矢奈子”的魔女。她在面包店工作，与人友好。

当一场神秘的瘟疫降临小镇时，那些人却背叛了她…… 
她友好的邻居变成了嗜血的暴徒，
当他们无缘无故地杀死了Yaneko的父亲时，
她发誓要报仇…… 

这是一部感人肺腑、情感丰富的乙女魔女奇幻小说，以中世纪欧洲为背景，讲述苦难和复仇。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE124817.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
